title: The Seventh Seal and the Golden Censer, The First Four Trumpets

questions.question: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was ____ in heaven for about half an hour.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:1 (ESV): "When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour."

questions.question: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven ____ were given to them.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:2 (ESV): "Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them."

questions.question: And another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden ____, and he was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne,
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:3 (ESV): "And another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer, and he was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne,"

questions.question: and the smoke of the incense, with the ____ of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:4 (ESV): "and the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel."

questions.question: Then the angel took the censer and filled it with ____ from the altar and threw it on the earth, and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:5 (ESV): "Then the angel took the censer and filled it with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth, and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake."

questions.question: Now the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to ____ them.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:6 (ESV): "Now the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to blow them."

questions.question: The first angel blew his trumpet, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with ____, and these were thrown upon the earth...
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:7 (ESV): "The first angel blew his trumpet, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and these were thrown upon the earth. And a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up."

questions.question: What fraction of the earth, trees, and sea were affected by the first and second trumpets?
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:7-8 records that a third of the earth, trees, sea, and living creatures in the sea were affected or destroyed.

questions.question: The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great ____, burning with fire, was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:8 (ESV): "The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain, burning with fire, was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood."

questions.question: The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great ____ fell from heaven, blazing like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:10 (ESV): "The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, blazing like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water."

questions.question: The name of the star is ____. A third of the waters became ____, and many people died from the water, because it had been made bitter.
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:11 (ESV): "The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the water, because it had been made bitter."

questions.question: The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the ____ was struck, and a third of the ____, and a third of the ____, so that a third of their light might be darkened...
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:12 (ESV): "The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of their light might be darkened, and a third of the day might be kept from shining, and likewise a third of the night."

questions.question: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew directly overhead, "____, ____, ____ to those who dwell on the earth, at the blasts of the other trumpets that the three angels are about to blow!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:13 (ESV): "Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew directly overhead, 'Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, at the blasts of the other trumpets that the three angels are about to blow!'"

questions.question: What bird flew directly overhead crying out "Woe, woe, woe"?
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:13 (ESV): "Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew directly overhead, 'Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, at the blasts of the other trumpets that the three angels are about to blow!'"

questions.question: What came from the golden censer and rose before God, before it was filled with fire and thrown to earth?
questions.explanation: Revelation 8:4 (ESV): "and the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel."

key_verse_text: And another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer, and he was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne, and the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel.
